rubric.question: Is everything stated consistent with the inputs (and sources, where used), with nothing invented?
Would the intended user act on this output with little or no editing?
Does it cover everything the task asks for, without padding?
Is every proposed action exactly what you would approve (right recipient or record, right content)?

expectedFailureBehavior: Nothing is sent or changed during the run; every action waits for approval of its exact payload.
A provider error during reads fails the run without drafting.
An approval can be used once; unclear outcomes are recorded as unconfirmed.
knownGaps: Provider responses are canned; no real provider has been called.
